{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
* 2 packages [[Cookbook:Instant Noodles|instant]] [[Cookbook:Ramen Noodle|ramen]] or [[Cookbook:Udon|udon noodles]] with flavoring mix
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Sausage|sausages]]
* ½ medium [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], chopped

== Procedure ==

# Bring 1.5 [[Cookbook:Liter|liters]] of water to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]].
# Add noodles to to boiling water with one of flavoring packets.
# Add chopped tomatoes and sausages. Boil for 5 minutes.
# Add chopped onion and serve.
